messages.subject: [Catlearn-package] Catlearn 0.6 release schedule
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Catlearn version 0.6 is scheduled for release on CRAN by 13th July.

If you've not contributed to catlearn before, but would like to for the next
release, please drop me a line. If you have already contributed, please see the
'for developers' note at the end of the email.

All the best

Andy

FOR DEVELOPERS:

In order to allow sufficient time for code review, bug testing, and package
construction, feature freeze is on 2018-07-01 23:59 UTC+0:00. Any code or
updates you want to include in version 0.6 must be in your R-forge branch by
this time, in what you believe to be a fully working state.
